notes: v1 = the in-game veg_4 oak and birch. 18,996 tris for four trees.

defects.text: Oak crown is a flat umbrella on three Y-shaped limbs (acacia silhouette); an English oak has a broad rounded dome with several heavy spreading limbs.
defects.fix: Steeper, shorter heavy limbs plus a dome fill of foliage clusters, trunk radius up.

defects.text: Oak and birch leaf cards look like compound acacia/fern leaflets, not an oak leaf (lobed) or a birch leaf (ovate, toothed).
defects.fix: New cards with drawn lobed oak leaves (4-5 lobes) and toothed ovate birch leaves with veins.

defects.text: Oak bark is almost black (mean albedo about 0.07); real oak bark is grey-brown with deep fissures.
defects.fix: Lighter grey-brown fissured bark (same height detail).

defects.text: Birch crown is a narrow column of drooping sprays with the white trunk showing; silver birch has a more open, wider crown with fine drooping twigs.
defects.fix: More, longer, lower-elevation limbs (22, elevation 0.15-0.65), smaller leaf cards.

defects.text: Lowest point z = -0.076 m (sits-on-ground warning), roots slightly under ground.
